summary: Pointer drag in a real app: drag a file onto a folder in Nautilus
prompt: In the Files window, move "draft.md" into the "Archive" folder by dragging it with the mouse.
disabled: In a desk, each drag drops the PREVIOUS drag's file (a warm-up drag of notes.txt, then a drag of draft.md, put notes.txt in Archive), and the first drag drops nothing. Not yet known whether Hyprland or Nautilus holds on to the old offer. Runs only when named.
